messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add living NPC routines—sleeping, eating, working, and socializing—to the existing Elsewhere County game.

## Requirements
- Build the requested change without asking questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Verify with a small JPEG screenshot (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Added a county clock starting at 7:00 AM; one in-game day takes six real minutes at the default speed.
- NPC schedules vary by time of day; the UI shows each resident’s current activity, and clock speed can be adjusted.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented scheduled NPC activity, movement between routine locations, sleep posture, eating animation, and social gathering behavior.
- Added a resident activity panel and time controls.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Browser verification and requested screenshot have not yet been completed.

### Blocked
- Initial browser launch failed because Chromium was not installed. `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` completed successfully; browser verification can now be retried.

## Next Move
1. Retry `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`.
2. Begin the walk, inspect the NPC activity panel/scene, save and read a small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: NPC schedules, daily clock, movement, activity badges, and time controls.
- `index.html`: Resident activity panel and styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A dev server was started in tmux session `county-dev` on port 3002.
